premises.text: Diabetes care is inadequate because manual logging is tedious, digital tools are incompatible/hard to use, and no platform connects patients to their support network
premises.evidence_span: proper care for diabetes is inadequate and in many countries broken due to the following usability and technical problems

premises.text: A smart audio-jack cable connects existing glucometers to smart devices and is compatible with most meters, including in emerging markets, so users need not buy new hardware
premises.evidence_span: this smart cable is compatible with majority of the glucometers in the market, even those in emerging markets

premises.text: Companion software color-codes out-of-range readings, tags meals/meds/context, and shares interpretable graphs with doctors
premises.evidence_span: the data is also easily transferred as interpretable graphs, where it's for her benefit, or she can email or send it to the doctor

premises.text: A partner function lets family remotely view stats, send encouragement, and get alerts if the patient forgets to sync/test or numbers go out of range
premises.evidence_span: I can pre-set notifications that would alert me should grandma forget to sync to test herself or if her numbers are out of whack

premises.text: A patient-centric platform enables third-party interactions such as flexible insurance premiums, pharmacy marketing/rewards, and future API/service partnerships
premises.evidence_span: HealthiSync also enables a patient-centric platform. enabling new forms of interaction with third parties to the patient

premises.text: Go-to-market launches in Europe, China, U.S., and Taiwan with U.S. service-provider partnership discussions underway
premises.evidence_span: we will be launching in markets like Europe, China, U.S., Taiwan, and partnership discussions with service providers in the U.S.

value.text: Patients regain control of diabetes by aggregating glucose data and sharing it with their care network
value.evidence_span: Health to Sync aggregates glucose data, ultimately giving control back to you

causal_links.evidence_span: This smart solution, along with the software that we're offering, basically solved three issues
To control diabetes is about controlling glucose
enabling new forms of interaction with third parties to the patient
we will be launching in markets like Europe, China, U.S., Taiwan

notes: Three numbered usability pains folded as one problem set (§4.1.6). App tagging/graphs and partner alerts treated as cascade of the cable+software patient experience (§4.1.7). Third-party insurance/pharmacy/API path split as separately revisable platform module. Indiegogo ask excluded (§4.2.1). Four-domain partition; not a need/product/money triad.
